detail.longDescription: I set up my home server around 1.5 years ago, and somehow it's still super satisfying streaming music to the car from my phone, knowing that # Finamp , # Jellyfin , # Caddy , # CoreDNS , # netfilter , # Linux , # Docker , # Tailscale and # DuckDNS are all working together perfectly to make this miracle happen. Everything just works™. I'm so grateful to the people who make this possible by creating all of this software and the dependencies. Especially the ones who code it themselves. # SelfHosting # HomeServer
